description: Period Navigator replaces Power BI's default date slicer with a clean, minimal navigation experience. Use the ◀ ▶ arrows to move between months, quarters, or years — no dropdowns, no clutter. Designed for reports where simplicity matters. Period Navigator opens automatically on the latest completed period and filters all visuals on the page instantly. Features: - Navigate months, quarters, and years with a single click - Auto-defaults to the latest completed period - Full appearance control: colors, font size, background - Minimal footprint — fits any dashboard layout
